title: Nyxar Keyall
description: Nyxarkeyall is a plugin dedicated to creating keyalls on your server, with custom images, titles, sounds, and many more features!
body:
Introducing NyxarKeyAll

NyxarKeyAll is a modern and fully customizable KeyAll plugin designed to make global crate events easier, faster, and more interactive for your Minecraft server.

Simple to use, lightweight, and optimized for performance, NyxarKeyAll gives server owners complete control over how KeyAll events look, sound, and work.

What is NyxarKeyAll?

NyxarKeyAll is a high-performance Minecraft plugin that allows administrators to create and execute KeyAll events through an intuitive GUI menu or simple commands.

The plugin supports custom titles, sounds, animations, messages, and multiple crate systems, making it easy to integrate into any server setup while keeping gameplay immersive and professional.

Showcase
Interactive GUI System

Create and manage KeyAll events directly from an easy-to-use menu interface designed for quick configuration and smooth management.

Command Support

Execute KeyAll events instantly using commands with full administrator control and flexible customization.

Fully Customizable

Configure:

Titles
Sounds
Broadcast messages
Key amounts
Animations
Crate plugin support
GUI layouts
Permissions

Everything can be adjusted to match your server style perfectly.

Multiple Crate Plugin Support

NyxarKeyAll is designed to work with different crate plugins, allowing seamless integration into existing servers without complicated setup.
